RESPIRATION. [26] [Cham.]
Anxious breathing.
Oppressed breathing, as if chest was not wide enough.
Dyspnœa, constricted feeling at suprasternal fossa, with constant irritation to cough.
Dyspnœa, as from suffocative catarrh (larynx feels constricted) in region of pit of throat, a constant irritation to cough.
Suffocative dyspnœa, with sensation of being strangled by cord around trachea ; constant desire to cough.
Suffocative attacks from repercussion of measles eruption, by taking cold.
Rapid, deep breathing, with great heaving of chest.
Short, panting breath.
Short breath, with rattling.
Short, croaking breathing.
Draws short, deep breaths, with great elevation of thorax.
Rattling breathing, with cough.
Rattling breathing, slow inspiration and rapid expiration.
Sour smelling or fetid breath.
Loud, rattling, sighing or unequal respiration.
Snoring inspirations during sleep, which are shorter than the expirations, with open mouth and hot, clammy sweat on forehead.
Asthma after a fit of anger.
Asthmatic attack, seemingly produced by an accumulation of flatus, > from bending head back, in cold air, and from drinking cold water ; < in dry weather and from warm diet.
Asthma from vapors of sulphur, after Pulsat.
   

COUGH. [27] [Cham.]
The child becomes angry and then coughs.
Cough and hoarseness with rattling mucus in trachea, especially during winter.
Constant irritation to cough, beneath upper part of sternum.
Constant desire to cough, with sensation of cord around trachea.
Cough caused by irritation low down in air passages, during night.
Cough from tickling in chest.
Paroxysms of coughing about midnight, with which something seems to rise in throat, as if she would suffocate.
Cough, particularly at night, with tough, slimy expectoration, tasting bitter and putrid.
Dry cough < at night and during sleep.
Cough, with expectoration during day, without at night.
Dry cough from catching cold.
Rough, scraping cough of children in winter, with tickling in suprasternal fossa, < at night.
Dry cough, continuing during sleep.
Cough dry and hacking ; child is very fretful.
Scraping, dry cough, caused by tickling in pit of throat, < at night, even in sleep, especially with children after taking cold in winter.
Rough, dry cough. θ Sequel to measles.
Cough, with flushes of heat in face, at same time chilliness of limbs and back.
Cough threatens to burst chest. θ Rheumatism.
Amelioration of cough, when getting warm in bed.
Expectoration bloody, dark and coagulated.
Cough, with rattling in chest.
Expectoration : acrid, blood coagulated ; dark ; mucous ; viscous ; watery.
Taste of expectoration : bitter, putrid, or sour.
Catarrhal stage of whooping cough, with constant irritating, dry cough.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Cham.]
Burning pain under sternum, and from beneath sternum to mouth.
Burning in chest, with dulness in head, as if he did not know where he was, with anxiety.
Constriction in upper part of chest, which hurts on coughing.
Tensive pain across chest, when breathing.
Sudden stitches and darts through chest, extorting screams ; dyspnœa taking away voice and threatening suffocation. θ Rheumatism.
Single severe stitches in chest at times.
Stitches in chest from abdomen after each start, as in a fright, when waking or sleeping.
Chest painful, when coughing.
Stitches in sides of chest.
Stitches shoot from abdomen into middle of chest, as from flatulence.
Stitches in side of chest beneath ribs and shoulder blades, when breathing.
Pain in chest with every deep breath. θ Rheumatism.
Chest is sore internally as if bruised.
Oppression of chest as from flatus, which has accumulated in upper part of abdomen.
Heavy feeling in chest.
Pressive pain beneath sternum, which impedes breathing.
Drawing pain, or sensation as if right side of chest was repeatedly drawn inward.
Oppression of chest, short, moaning breathing, with pain in chest, sometimes stitches, on taking a deep breath.
Rattling of mucus in chest.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Cham.]
Palpitation and faintness.
Uneasiness about heart, faints frequently ; twitching of limbs ; oppression of chest. θ Shock of injury.
Pain in heart, as if something weighed it down. θ Cardialgia.
A kind of faintness ; he becomes sick and qualmish about heart, feet suddenly feel paralyzed, with heaviness of all limbs, as if they were worn out.
Shooting stitches in precordial region, thence to various parts of body.
Rapid stitches about heart, on motion, interfering with breathing.
Pulse small, but tense and accelerated. θ Neuralgia.
Pulse frequently very unequal, and for at time weak.
Pulse first full, then again weak and contracted.
Pulse small and uneven.
   

OUTER CHEST. [30] [Cham.]
Tearing pain in region of clavicle and throat.
Whole thorax feels as if beaten. θ Rheumatism.
A hard node beneath nipple, painful to touch, with drawing tearing pain.
Scirrhous hardness of mammary glands.
